an abstract domain: a Java class the engine calls to analyze programs.

whose opening line is three backticks, then `java`, then the file's path:

package pag.domains.gen;
...
```

directories under them match the package. Anything outside those blocks is
ignored, so explain in comments if you need to explain.

private Octagon toOctagon(LinExpr diff) {
  if (diff.isConst()) return null;
  if (diff.isOneVar()) {
    String v = diff.var(); BigInteger c = diff.coeff();
    if (c.equals(ONE)) return new Octagon(index(v), 0, diff.constant);
    if (c.equals(ONE.neg())) return new Octagon(0, index(v), diff.constant);
    return null;
  }
  if (diff.terms.size() == 2) {
    String pos = null, neg = null;
    for (Map.Entry<String,BigInteger> e : diff.terms.entrySet()) {
      if (e.getValue().equals(ONE)) pos = e.getKey();
      else if (e.getValue().equals(ONE.neg())) neg = e.getKey();
      else return null;
    }
    if (pos != null && neg != null) return new Octagon(index(pos), index(neg), diff.constant);
  }
  return null;
}

}
